vit-cry-002.sentence: Attesters only vote for the proposer's block if it includes transactions from all stored ILs.
In each slot, a set of validators is selected as inclusion list (IL) committee members. Each member builds and gossips one IL according to their subjective view of the mempool.
FOCIL implements a robust mechanism to preserve Ethereum's censorship resistance properties by guaranteeing timely transaction inclusion.
The proposer (or the builder if the block is not built locally by the proposer) includes transactions from all collected ILs in its block.

vit-cry-003.sentence: Clients must stop serving historical headers, bodies, and receipts older than 33,024 epochs on the p2p layer.
Clients SHOULD NOT serve headers, block bodies, and receipts that are older than HISTORY_PRUNE_EPOCHS epochs on the p2p network.
